requirement: Filters keep the page's place
expected: Choosing a filter low in the column does not jump to the top; the results come into view only when off-screen.
preconditions: Catalog with listings in several places.
steps: On /listados at 1366 px scroll to Ubicación and tick a place.

requirement: Free-text search over brand, model, type and title
expected: strato, "stratocaster", "cajon" and "bass" find their listings; every word must match.
steps: Search each word from the header.

requirement: Search forgives typos and ignores accents
expected: guitara finds guitars; "cajón" and "cajon" find the same.

requirement: A phrase becomes editable filters
expected: bajo 5 cuerdas menos de 2000 en Lima opens the catalog with Bajos, 5 cuerdas, Hasta S/ 2,000 and Lima as chips.

requirement: Hidden and pending listings are never found
expected: A hidden listing's words return nothing.

requirement: Search alerts keep the text
expected: Creating an alert on a text search saves the query; a new listing matching it notifies.
steps: Search, Crear alerta; publish a matching listing.

requirement: The header search keeps the filters
expected: Searching from /listados?category=guitars&location=Lima keeps both; "Buscar en todo el catálogo" drops them.
steps: Search "fender" from that page, then use the escape.

requirement: Headings and tab titles say what was searched
expected: The h1 reads “fender” en Guitarras · Lima and the tab adds the count.

requirement: Suggestions with counts as you type
expected: After two letters the list offers categories, types, brands and models with listings and their counts; arrows and Enter work.

requirement: Zero results rescue the search
expected: No results offers "Sin “X” hay N" buttons, the closest listings and the alert.

requirement: Places come from listings, grouped by zone
expected: Ubicación lists only places with listings, by zone with "Todo …".

requirement: Cards show the store's district
expected: A store listing's card shows district and city.

requirement: No brand or type link leads to an empty page
expected: Menu and landing brands and types each have listings; empty categories are hidden on the home.
steps: Open the menus, a landing and the home.

requirement: Counts on filters and on the sheet's button
expected: Each option shows its count; the phone sheet's button reads "Ver N resultados" and updates with the draft.
steps: Open the sheet at 390 px and change options.

requirement: Price shortcuts follow the prices on sale
expected: Three chips from the price spread and the range hint; none with fewer than three prices.

requirement: Back to results at the same place
expected: From a listing opened in the results, "Volver a resultados" returns to the same search and scroll; Anterior/Siguiente move through them.
steps: Scroll, open the fourth card, use the arrows and go back.

requirement: New sorts
expected: Bajaron de precio lists recent drops first with the previous price; "Tiendas verificadas primero" lists verified stores first.
preconditions: A listing with a price drop.

requirement: Recently viewed on the device
expected: Opened listings appear in "Vistos recientemente" on the home, catalog and not-found page; "Borrar" forgets them.
steps: Open two listings, visit each page, press Borrar.

requirement: Compare up to three listings
expected: Desktop ticks gather in a tray; /comparar shows a side-by-side table marking differences; a fourth tick is disabled.
steps: Tick two or three cards, Comparar.

requirement: Compare from favorites on phones
expected: Comparar favoritas lets the buyer pick two or three and opens /comparar.

requirement: Ver 24 más on phones
expected: Below 768 px the next page loads below; back restores the added listings; numbered links stay in the HTML.
steps: Press Ver 24 más, open a card, go back.

requirement: A gone listing points to similar ones
expected: A once-public, now hidden listing's address shows "Esta publicación ya no está disponible" and live listings of its type, nothing else about it.

requirement: Instant listing and back
expected: The first cards' pages are prefetched; hover prefetches the rest; back is instant.

requirement: The home starts with instruments
expected: On a phone the first listings appear within the first screen and a half; category chips sit under the search.

requirement: Para ti ranks on the device and explains itself
expected: After opening listings, "Para ti" leads with similar ones, never two of one seller in a row; "¿Por qué veo esto?" lists the reasons; "Empezar de cero" and "Sin personalizar" work.

requirement: ¿Qué tocas? is optional
expected: A first visit shows the row; "Saltar" hides it for good; choosing orders "Para ti".

requirement: Nuevo desde tu última visita
expected: After 30 minutes away, listings published since the last visit are shown first.

requirement: Personal signals stay on the device
expected: No request carries taste, recently viewed or comparison data; the server sends only hashed seller keys.
steps: Inspect network requests on the home.
